description_en: Lists the push rules for a specified repository. This operation does not support pagination
description_zh: 查询指定代码库下的推送规则列表，无分页
name: ListPushRules

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can find this ID in the URL of your organization's page on the Alibaba Cloud DevOps platform: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or a Security Token Service (STS) token for authentication
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

gmtCreate.description_en: The time when the rule was created

gmtModified.description_en: The time when the rule was last updated

id.description_en: The ID of the push rule

checkerName.description_en:
The name of the rule checker. Valid values include:

`CommitMessageChecker`: The commit message rule.

`CommitAuthorEmailChecker`: The commit author email rule.

`CommitAuthorChecker`: The commit author check.

`CommitCommitterChecker`: The committer check.

`ForcePushChecker`: The force push check.

`CommitFilesChecker`: The committed file restriction rule
checkerName.description_zh:
规则名称，可选值：
CommitMessageChecker：提交说明规则
CommitAuthorEmailChecker：提交邮箱规则
CommitAuthorChecker：提交作者检查
CommitCommitterChecker：提交人检查
ForcePushChecker：禁止强制推送检查
CommitFilesChecker：提交文件限制规则

checkerType.description_en:
Specifies the restriction level. This parameter is valid only for the commit author check and the committer check. It is optional for other rules. Valid values:

`warn`: Issues a warning but allows the push.

`block`: Blocks the push
checkerType.description_zh:
该字段作用于代码属主检查下的限制级别设置，仅检查作者和检查提交者有效，其他规则可不传值，可选值：

warn：仅警告，允许推送
block：禁止推送

extraMessage.description_en:
Provides additional configuration for certain rule checkers:

For a `commit message rule`, this specifies the `regular expression` for the commit message.

For a `commit author email rule`, this specifies the `regular expression` for the author's email address.

For a `force push check`, set this value to `"disabled"`.

For a `commit author check`, set this value to `"on"` to enable the check. Omit this parameter to disable the check.

For a `committer check`, set this value to `"on"` to enable the check. Omit this parameter to disable the check
extraMessage.description_zh:
在提交说明、提交邮箱、检查作者、检查提交人以及禁止强制推送时有效：
提交说明规则，extraMessage传入检查的正则表达式
提交邮箱规则，extraMessage传入检查的邮箱正则表示
禁止强制推送，extraMessage传入 "disabled"
检查作者规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值
检查提交人规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值

fileRuleRegexes.description_en: This parameter is valid only for the committed file restriction rule. You can provide one or more regular expressions to restrict committed files
fileRuleRegexes.description_zh: 该字段仅作用于提交文件限制，传入正则表达式，支持多条正则限制

items.description_en: A regular expression used to restrict file paths

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
